'''Chapter 567''' is titled "Marineford Marine Headquarters - Oris Plaza".

==Cover Page==
[[Color spreads|Color spread]]: The [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] with their numbers as various fruit themed superheroes.

==Short Summary==
As [[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]] prepares to launch another attack, he is blocked by [[Kuzan|Aokiji]], forcing [[Jozu]] to step in. [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], progressing through the [[Marines]], is attacked and thrown by back by a pair of [[Vice Admirals]] and [[Admiral]] [[Borsalino|Kizaru]]. Whitebeard tells Luffy to stay back, and proceeds to clash with [[Sakazuki|Akainu]]. [[Polo Marco|Marco]], meanwhile, makes a beeline for [[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]], but is punched away by [[Monkey D. Garp|Garp]].
==Long Summary==
The Whitebeard Pirates and their subordinate crews began their assault on the plaza. Whitebeard prepares to use a devastating attack, but Admiral [[Kuzan|Aokiji]] freezes Whitebeard using Ice Ball. Whitebeard breaks free from the ice he was encased in and attacked Aokiji. Aokiji prepares to counter with Ice Block Partisan, but [[Jozu]] attacked him before he can do so. Jozu and Aokiji prepare to face off against each other.

[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], meanwhile, continues to move toward the execution platform. However, Momonga and Dalmatian stand in Luffy's way and attack him. Luffy then gets struck down by Admiral Kizaru, who told Luffy that courage alone is not enough and kicked him away. Luffy is sent flying and is then caught by Whitebeard. Kizaru chides [[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]] for allowing Luffy to lead the charge. Whitebeard then hand Luffy to his men and says that Luffy has done enough. As Whitebeard's men try to tend to Luffy's wounds, Luffy insisted to go on but soon collapses. Whitebeard comments on how he held a soft spot for people like Luffy.

Whitebeard prepares to attack again, but is intercepted by [[Sakazuki|Akainu]]. Akainu tells Whitebeard that his power can destroy Marineford. Whitebeard responds by saying that he should try to protect it. Akainu launches a magma fist and Whitebeard counters with an air quake.

[[Polo Marco|Marco]] attempts to reach Ace in his phoenix form. [[Monkey D. Garp|Garp]] intercepts him and says to the Whitebeard Pirates that they will have to get past Garp before they can save [[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]].
